lines_read_unit: nonblank checked source lines excluding comments and scan markers
visual_notes: Both supplied images read completely, including the blank lower half and all margins. Enlarged the F/P/v placement. Corrected typed v positions, one K/k reading, and a supplied closing bracket; kept the empty inclusion slot and incomplete corollary wording with exact French references. Additional paired-glyph placement review confirmed every attached xi; no further change.

decisions.reason: The typed lowercase v is on the ordinary P baseline.
The first index has a lowercase k, distinctly unlike the later capital K in Corollary 5.7.
The Pv after the arrow has a baseline v, not an exponent.
The enlarged formula shows underlined P lowered below F, while v is on the same text level as the v of the preceding Pv. Preserve the separate baseline v.
The Pv in the corollary also has a baseline v.
Only the opening square bracket is printed; after fascicule the scan has a comma, not a closing bracket.
The number is printed, with no pen strokes discernible.
All heading characters read directly.
The underline is plainly present.

decisions.reason: Cote 25 site 24, editorial paragraph after 5.7: «une simple référence à des conditions énumérées dans un autre fascicule». Blass’s chapter [fascicule gloss is retained, including its missing closing bracket.

The height and diagonals distinguish K from the earlier lowercase k.
